Skyler needs inspiration! She's struggling to design a logo for the famous Café Moi, so she ventures out to the streets of Paris. Will the beauty of the city help influence her designs? Meanwhile, Kia's dream date takes an unexpected turn when she spots Laurent buying flowers for someone else! Will Violet's puppy therapy help calm her down? The Paris adventure continues! Bella, Skyler, Violet, and Kia meet at Café Moi to help each other through their biggest challenges yet. Bella is ready to give up on her Eiffel Tower runway exam, Kia worries Laurent has broken her heart, and Skyler is stuck trying to create the perfect logo for Café Moi. Luckily, four adorable puppies have other plans!
